svg.title: designyourtv's glass widgets
svg.desc: The TV's glass widgets, one at a time, each shown on the painting it sits on, in real frames from the demo: Calendar: The month at a glance, with today ringed in the painting's own accent. Next event: The next entry from any ICS calendar feed, counting down to it. Bus arrivals: Live arrivals from Singapore's LTA DataMall, smoothed so a bus never drops out for one bad reading. Batteries: Phone, tablet, watch and earbuds as rings, read over adb from the phones themselves. Claude limits: Session and weekly use of a Claude plan, from a small headless probe at most every 10 minutes. Claude Code: Daily Claude Code activity, read from its own transcripts. Until the hub has some, the card says it is a sample. Weekly pace: How much of the weekly limit today allows (86 %) against what is used (41 %). Now playing: Follows whatever the TV itself is playing, with pause and skip.
